features.title: Why the Husma card?
features.desc: The Husma system is transparent, easy to understand, and gives you real value.
features.1Desc: 1 coin for every 1,000 UZS (including Husma Fit and Mavi restaurant).
features.2Desc: Exclusive discounts at Mavi restaurant, Spa, fitness, and on rooms.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.desc: Got questions? Find the answers here.
faq.1q: Do I have to pay for the card?
faq.1a: No. Signing up and opening a card are completely free.
faq.2a: 1 coin is earned for every 1,000 UZS spent.
faq.3q: Where can I use the 50,000 UZS discount?
faq.3a: The discount is granted when you install the app and is valid at Husma hotel, Husma Fit, and Mavi restaurant.
faq.4a: Once you earn the required number of coins, you move up to the corresponding level (e.g., 99,000 — Bronze, 999,000 — VIP).
